title: The Vanishing at the Grand Hotel

suspects.name: Olivia Grant
suspects.motive: Margaret planned to replace Olivia after discovering management problems.

suspects.name: James Porter
suspects.motive: Margaret had threatened to close the hotel's restaurant.

suspects.name: Isabelle Moore
suspects.motive: Margaret disputed a recent financial recommendation.

suspects.name: Daniel Frost
suspects.motive: Margaret blamed Daniel for repeated maintenance failures.

clues.name: The Management Letter
clues.description: A letter indicates that Margaret was considering replacing Olivia as hotel manager.

clues.name: The Service Elevator Log
clues.description: An access log records a service elevator trip toward the private suites. The passenger is unidentified.

clues.name: The Reception Witness
clues.description: A guest recalls speaking with Olivia near reception at approximately 20:42, but the timing is uncertain.

clues.name: The Kitchen Inventory
clues.description: A kitchen inventory was signed by James during the evening, but the exact signing time is unclear.

clues.name: The Altered Invoice
clues.description: An invoice contains an unexplained change connected to hotel maintenance expenditure.

clues.name: The Corridor Footprints
clues.description: Footprints near the service corridor are too indistinct to identify their owner.

clues.name: The Missing Room Key
clues.description: A spare key to the private suite cannot be located. Several employees had access to the key cabinet.

clues.name: The Unsent Appointment
clues.description: A draft appointment request shows that Margaret intended to meet someone privately, but the recipient is missing.
